about_the_game:
Kat and Mat are two cats living peacefully in their cozy home… until one day, a mysterious stranger appears, leaving behind strange floating bouncing balls and kidnapping Mat—vanishing into the sky. Is this some kind of test for little Kat? Whatever it is, she’s determined to climb as high as it takes to bring Mat back.

Bounce Cat is a challenging platformer where every jump matters, and every bounce could bring you closer to the top… or send you all the way back down.

🟡 Key Features:

– Jump and bounce with precision to ascend through a vertical world
– One small mistake could mean a huge fall
– Addictive and demanding gameplay with a rewarding learning curve
– Take a break from climbing and meow your own melodies with a unique music system
– Paw at different objects to knock them down and collect them all
– Discover hidden areas and unlock adorable outfits for Kat

Get ready for a vertical adventure with a feline heart, where the challenge lies in every jump… and the reward is never giving up.

  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 650
  • DirectX: Version 10

  • Processor: Intel Core i5

short_description: A challenging vertical platformer where every jump counts. Bounce with precision, avoid harsh falls, and explore hidden areas. Unlock outfits, collect items, and relax by playing meow-sical melodies with Kat. How high can you climb?
